citations.claim: Body reset + fixed overlay/legend/hint/credit panels + pill styling
Build job: npm ci → next build (NODE_ENV=production) → touch .nojekyll → upload Pages artifact

runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
      - uses: actions/configure-pages@v5
      - run: npm ci
      - r

citations.claim: Deploy job: actions/deploy-pages@v4 publishes to github-pages environment
citations.snippet:
deploy:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4
